clips.title: The story
paras: At Teldrassil's southern shore, Rut'theran Village links Darnassus to Kalimdor by sea and sky. Ferries and hippogryphs carry travelers between the World Tree and the mainland.

Rut'theran Village meets the water below Teldrassil's towering heights. Darnassus rests in the boughs above, while the village handles its needs beyond the tree. A mystical portal beneath the trees carries travelers between the shore and Darnassus in an instant. Ferries leave the docks for Auberdine on the mainland coast of Darkshore, and flight masters tend roosts of trained hippogryphs.
